title: Add-on Bundles Pilot: telemetry retention tiers + compliance-questionnaire mapping
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a cross-functional pilot to validate packaging and pricing for: (1) observability retention tiers as a billable add-on, (2) a Compliance Pack (audit-ready logs + DPA/KMS options) sold as an enterprise add-on, and (3) Premium SLA (4× availability + white-glove support). The pilot covers product changes, billing wiring, contract questionnaire mapping, and a minimal legal/CS playbook for enterprise negotiations. Goals: determine conversion lift, unit economics changes, and contract friction points for inclusion in 2026 pricing roadmap.
acceptance_criteria: Three pricing variants defined and implemented in Console feature flagging: Basic (no addons), Observability-Tiered, Compliance+SLA bundle
Billing emits distinct SKU usage and invoicing line items for retention tiers and compliance pack within Redwood billing pipeline
Contract questionnaire template (security & legal responses) updated with pruned Qs resolved by Compliance Pack; legal sign-off on three template addenda
Pilot run with 6 existing sales opportunities and 12 self-serve accounts for at least 4 weeks, with conversion and revenue metrics collected
Playbook for sales and CSM including negotiation map, pricing floor, and fallback concessions (e.g., trial retention extension) documented in Drive
comments: 2026-02-17 - Aisha: Kickoff complete. Aligned with Eng, Legal, Sales Engineering. Primary KPI: delta ARR per seat and time-to-close for enterprise deals.
2026-02-24 - Miguel: Engineering spike complete for retention-tiered storage. Implemented separate retention SKUs and a new billing hook. Proof-of-concept emits events to billing queue (ENG-3822).

2026-03-01 - Legal (Claire Huang): Reviewed compliance pack language. Need explicit data residency clause and KMS integration checklist before we offer as managed add-on. Recommend adding a short DPA addendum template.

2026-03-04 - Design (Ravi Patel): Console mockups for opt-in telemetry consent and billing toggle posted. UX notes: make retention level selection visible on project settings and when enabling observability add-on.
2026-03-08 - Sales (Leila Mor): Proposed pilot cohort of 6 opportunities in EMEA and NA. Concern: Premium SLA pricing elasticity unknown for deals under $50k ARR.
2026-03-12 - Miguel: Started A/B rollout using feature-flagged offering. Backend metrics wired; first 12 self-serve accounts enrolled in Observability-Tiered variant.
2026-03-12 - Aisha: Action items: (1) Legal to draft DPA addendum by 2026-03-20; (2) Billing to validate invoice samples by 2026-03-18; (3) CS to prepare negotiation playbook draft by 2026-03-25.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: aggressive retention tiers improve observability revenue but increase storage costs—we will track gross margin by SKU. Compliance Pack reduces friction on security questionnaires but may require localization for APAC customers. Premium SLA priced as a % uplift vs committed capacity; will include revenue share for white-glove support hours.
next_steps: Legal to finalize DPA addendum and KMS checklist (due 2026-03-20)
Billing to produce invoice preview for two pilot customers (due 2026-03-18)
CS to run negotiation playbook dry-run with Sales on 2026-03-19
Measure conversion and churn over 30 days and report results in 2026-W14 review
